description: Baseline fakegreg prompt set spanning reference, landing, dashboard, docs, pricing, and anti-example surfaces.

entries.prompt: Create a beautiful, complete, self-contained modern landing page for a global edge AI product with an interactive network visual, // kickers, geometric unicode icons, a styled code quickstart, and big credible metrics.
Build a landing page for ForgeNet, a global mesh for specialized agents. Make it feel like a Greg-style infrastructure launch page.
Enhance the ForgeNet landing with stronger canvas layers, sharper copy, and more Meridian-like polish while keeping it runnable.
Create an ops dashboard for RelayOps, a global incident coordination mesh for AI infrastructure teams. Keep the Greg proof density, but translate it into an operator control surface.
Create a developer docs home for VectorDocs, a distributed vector database. Preserve Greg hierarchy and polish while prioritizing quickstarts and navigation clarity.
Create a React/TSX pricing page for MeshDB, a privacy-first global sync database, with Greg-style packaging narrative, credible usage numbers, and strong enterprise framing.
Control specimen: intentionally generic cloud landing page to act as a negative example for Greg fidelity.
